description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex, which implements a DOM-based HTML tokenizer using PHP's DOM extension. It contains methods to parse HTML into tokens, handle DOM nodes, and manipulate HTML comments and tags for purification purposes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an HTML lexer using DOMDocument to parse and tokenize HTML content for purification.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Main method to convert HTML string into tokens using DOM parsing.

methods.name: tokenizeDOM
methods.description: Recursively tokenizes a DOM node and its children.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Retrieves the tag name of a DOM node, handling various libxml versions.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data from a DOM node, handling various libxml versions.

methods.name: createStartNode
methods.description: Creates a start token for a DOM element or text node.

methods.name: createEndNode
methods.description: Creates an end token for a DOM element node.

methods.name: transformAttrToAssoc
methods.description: Converts DOM attributes to an associative array.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A no-op error handler to suppress DOM loading errors.

methods.name: wrapHTML
methods.description: Wraps HTML fragment in a full HTML document with optional doctype.

methods.name: aggressivelyFixLt
methods.description: Fixes stray '<' characters in HTML comments.

methods.name: manipulateHtmlComments
methods.description: Modifies HTML comments in the content using a callback.
